name: Strength
text: Attacks deal this much more damage per hit.

name: Dexterity
text: Gain this much more block whenever you gain block.

name: Vulnerable
text: Takes 50% more damage from attacks. Wears off by 1 each turn.

name: Weak
text: Attacks deal 25% less damage. Wears off by 1 each turn.

name: Frail
text: Gains 25% less block. Wears off by 1 each turn.

name: Poison
text: At the start of its turn, loses this much HP, ignoring block. Then it drops by 1.

name: Burn
text: At the start of its turn, takes this much damage. Then it drops by 1.

name: Chill
text: Each of its hits deals this much less. At {FREEZE_AT} Chill a normal enemy is Frozen; an elite or boss Shatters for {SHATTER_DAMAGE} instead. Wears off by 1 each turn.

name: Frozen
text: Skips its next action, then thaws.

name: Mark
text: Attacks against this enemy deal {MARK_BONUS} more. Each hit uses up one Mark.

name: Thorns
text: Whoever attacks this takes this much damage per hit.

name: Regen
text: Heals this much at the end of its turn. Then it drops by 1.

name: Artifact
text: The next debuff applied is negated instead. Each use spends one.

name: Plated Armor
text: Gains this much block at the end of its turn. Loses 1 whenever it takes HP damage.

name: Metallicize
text: Gains this much block at the end of its turn.

name: Intangible
text: Takes at most 1 damage from any source. Wears off by 1 each turn.

name: Images
text: The next attacks against you are negated, one image per attack.

name: Stunned
text: Skips its next action.

name: Waiting
text: Its next action is postponed one turn.

name: Ritual
text: Gains this much Strength at the end of its turn.

name: Enrage
text: Gains this much Strength whenever you play a Skill.

name: Bomb
text: When this enemy dies, every other enemy takes this much damage.

name: Exhaust
text: Removed from the fight when played. It comes back next fight.

name: Retain
text: Not discarded at the end of your turn.

name: Innate
text: Starts in your opening hand.

name: Ethereal
text: Exhausts if it is still in your hand at the end of your turn.

name: Unplayable
text: Cannot be played. It sits in your hand until discarded.

name: Armed
text: A trap. Playing it arms it; it waits, then fires once when its trigger happens. You can hold {TRAP_LIMIT}; a third replaces the oldest.

name: Holy Power
text: The Paladin's charge. Built by generator cards, spent by Verdicts. Holds up to {CAP_holyPower} and stays between turns in a fight.

name: Arcane Charge
text: The Mage's charge. Gained by Arcane cards; some spells hit harder per Charge, and Barrage-type cards spend them all. Holds up to {CAP_charge}.

name: Energy
text: What cards cost to play. It refills to your maximum at the start of every turn; what you do not spend is lost.

name: Block
text: Soaks damage before it reaches your HP. It lasts until your next turn starts.

name: Companion
text: The Tracker's animal. It acts at the end of your turn, cannot be hurt, and can be Stunned or Enraged.

name: Enraged
text: Your Companion's next action deals 3 more damage.

name: Secret
text: A card stolen from an enemy. Kill an enemy once and its Secret can turn up among your rewards.

name: X cost
text: Costs all the energy you have, and is stronger for every point spent.

name: ALL enemies
text: Hits every living enemy, not just one. No target needed.

name: Upgrade
text: A + card is the improved version: better numbers or a cheaper cost. Cards are upgraded at a Camp.

name: Trigger: an enemy attacks you
text: The trap fires the moment an enemy's attack lands on you.

name: Trigger: an enemy buffs itself
text: The trap fires when an enemy strengthens itself.

name: Trigger: the enemies' turn starts
text: The trap fires as soon as your turn ends.

name: Attack
text: It will hit you. The number is the damage, before your block.

name: Defend
text: It will gain block.

name: Buff
text: It will make itself stronger.

name: Debuff
text: It will weaken you.

name: Special
text: Something else is coming: a summon, a trick, a phase change.

name: Summon
text: It will call for help.

name: Hidden
text: Its next move is hidden. Expect anything.

name: Fight
text: A normal fight. Gold and a card.

name: Elite
text: A hard fight. A relic too, and the enemy's Secret is always offered.

name: Event
text: Something to read, and a choice.

name: Merchant
text: Cards, relics, vials, and card removal, for gold.

name: Camp
text: Rest to heal, or Smith to upgrade a card.

name: Treasure
text: A relic, free.

name: Unknown
text: Could be anything: an event most often, sometimes a fight, a merchant or treasure.

name: Boss
text: The chapter boss. Beat it and choose one of three boss relics.
